name: ghost-prompt
description: Ghost-text completions for your Copilot prompts — write faster, think clearer.
author: JaminSmoke

commands.title: GhostPrompt: Run Suggest Pipeline (External / VSOpenCodeX API)

ghostPrompt.completionProvider.markdownDescription: Legacy single-backend switch used **only** when `ghostPrompt.enabledCompletionSources` has never been set in User or Workspace settings. Prefer **enabledCompletionSources** for Copilot + OpenCode + Ollama together.

ghostPrompt.enabledCompletionSources.markdownDescription: Which completion backends appear in the GhostPrompt model dropdown and receive routed requests. Include **`copilot`** for GitHub Copilot LM (`vscode.lm`), **`opencode`** for the embedded OpenCode server, and **`ollama`** for local models via the Ollama API. Example: `["copilot", "ollama"]` lists **both**; GhostPrompt routes by selected model id. If this array is **unset** in settings (never saved), GhostPrompt keeps using **completionProvider** for backward compatibility.

ghostPrompt.opencodeExcludedModelIds.markdownDescription: OpenCode models to hide from the GhostPrompt dropdown. Use ids `providerID/modelID` (same as OpenCode). Ignored when completion provider is Copilot or Ollama.

ghostPrompt.ollamaBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the Ollama API. Defaults to `http://localhost:11434`. Change if Ollama runs on a different port or remote host.

ghostPrompt.ollamaExcludedModelIds.markdownDescription: Ollama model names to exclude from the GhostPrompt dropdown (e.g. `mistral:latest`). Only applies when the Ollama engine is active.

ghostPrompt.suggestionModelPolicy.markdownDescription: Policy to choose Copilot model for inline suggestions. `nonPremiumOnly` (safe default) uses only included (`0x`) models when metadata is available; `anyModel` allows first available model and may consume premium quota.

ghostPrompt.selectedModelId.markdownDescription: Preferred model id for inline suggestions. Use `auto` for automatic selection. With OpenCode, ids are `providerID/modelID`; the dropdown lists available models when the OpenCode runtime is running.

ghostPrompt.debugSuggestions.markdownDescription: Compatibility shim: when **on** and `ghostPrompt.logLevel` has never been set in User/Workspace/Folder settings, effective log level is **debug** (verbose pipeline + `GhostPrompt Log` channel). If `logLevel` is set explicitly, it wins. Prefer `ghostPrompt.logLevel` for new setups.

ghostPrompt.logLevel.markdownDescription: Minimum verbosity for **GhostPrompt Log** and structured file logs. `error` shows only errors; `debug` includes fine-grained host traces. When this key is unset at all scopes, `debugSuggestions` may still elevate to debug (see its description).

ghostPrompt.logFileEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled, append NDJSON + Markdown session logs under global storage `ghostPrompt/logs/v1/`.

ghostPrompt.logFileMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum size in bytes of `events.ndjson` before it is rotated (gzipped archive + new file).

ghostPrompt.showSuggestionIssueNotificat.markdownDescription: Show occasional VS Code notifications for actionable suggestion failures (missing Copilot/OpenCode, premium quota pause, OpenCode start/network/auth errors). Throttled to avoid spam; the webview status line remains primary.

ghostPrompt.maxSuggestionChars.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters for each inline suggestion after normalization.

ghostPrompt.suggestionStyle.markdownDescription: Controls how specific and long inline suggestions should be. `concise` keeps short continuations, `balanced` keeps practical context-rich responses, `detailed` allows richer multi-sentence continuations.

ghostPrompt.minCharsForSuggestion.markdownDescription: Minimum normalized character count required before requesting a suggestion.

ghostPrompt.suggestionDebounceMs.markdownDescription: Delay after you stop typing before GhostPrompt requests a suggestion (webview debounce). Higher = fewer Copilot/OpenCode calls while typing and fewer races; lower = faster ghost-text.

ghostPrompt.agentDestination.markdownDescription: Where the **full prompt** is sent from. `copilotChat` keeps GhostPrompt’s inline composer and **Send to Copilot**. `cursorChat` (Cursor IDE only) keeps the same GhostPrompt surface and sends to the native Cursor chat when the destination provider is registered. `vsOpenCodeX` disables that inline surface in the webview (chips stay); VSOpenCodeX drives focus and calls `ghostPrompt.runSuggestPipeline` with `{ text }` for suggestions. Inline UI updates are forwarded to VSOpenCodeX via `vsopencodex.ghostPromptInlineUi` when this is `vsOpenCodeX`. **Effective default:** if **VSOpenCodeX** is installed and you have **never** saved this key (User/Workspace), GhostPrompt behaves as **`vsOpenCodeX`** until you set it explicitly (Settings or **Destino** dropdown in the GhostPrompt view).

ghostPrompt.requestCooldownMs.markdownDescription: Minimum cooldown between repeated identical suggestion inputs.

ghostPrompt.cacheTtlMs.markdownDescription: How long suggestion cache entries are kept in memory (milliseconds).

ghostPrompt.rateLimitMaxRequests.markdownDescription: Maximum suggestion requests allowed within the configured rate limit window.

ghostPrompt.rateLimitWindowMs.markdownDescription: Window size in milliseconds used by rate limiting.

ghostPrompt.sessionRequestBudget.markdownDescription: Maximum number of suggestion model requests allowed per extension session.
